title: LogoColorwayGeneratorInput
description: Input schema for the Logo Colorway Generator skill

brand_name.description: Exact brand name or wordmark shown in the existing logo

source_logo_description.description: Description of the existing logo, generated board, symbol, mascot feature, wordmark, layout, and what must be preserved

brand_context.description: Optional brand context, audience, category, personality, and usage surfaces

palette_direction.description: Optional color direction, desired mood, specific colors, or colors to avoid

color_impact.description: How strongly the colorway should affect first-glance recognition. memorable is the default; high-impact uses bolder fields and stronger contrast while preserving the logo.

layout_mode.description: How much the surrounding board layout can change. adaptive-scenario-board changes background/layout for practical applications; preserve-original-board keeps the original grid.

audience_scope.description: Audience breadth for color choices. broad-mainstream favors widely acceptable, memorable palettes.

background_direction.description: Optional direction for the board background or scene environment, such as bold coral field, deep blue interface, warm retail wall, outdoor product scene, or split color blocks.

colorway_count.description: Number of palette routes to propose before choosing the strongest one

output_layout.description: Preferred direct-render layout. colorway-board preserves the existing board and adds palette swatches and color applications.

target_platform.description: Which image model prompts to emphasize; default outputs all variants

render_image.description: When true, generate an actual recolored logo or colorway board after creating the final prompt if an image-generation tool is available

revision_notes.description: Iteration feedback when refining a previous colorway

examples.source_logo_description: Existing mascot-derived brand-system board with koi tail split and water ripple symbol, exact wordmark Aster Koi, black/ivory editorial grid, favicon, seal, lockup, applications, mockup, embossed print, and symbol meaning modules.
examples.brand_context: Premium tea and botanical lifestyle brand for packaging, cup sleeves, small seals, and storefront signage.
examples.palette_direction: warm ivory base with a memorable persimmon signature color, pond green support, and ink black
examples.background_direction: warm persimmon and ivory scenario board with packaging and cup sleeve applications
